skill.name: audit
skill.description: Perform comprehensive audit of interface quality across accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive design. Generates detailed report of issues with severity ratings and recommendations.
skill.summary: Audit frontend quality across accessibility, performance, theming, responsive design, and design anti-patterns.
skill.author: pbakaus

security_audit.summary: The three static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples that wrap slash commands in backticks. No evidence found for shell execution, command injection, network access, data exfiltration, or prompt injection in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - "Use `/normalize` to align with design system (addresses N theming issues)"
- "Use `/optimize` to improve performance (addresses N performance issues)"
- "Use `/harden` to improve resilience (addresses N edge cases)"

content.value_statement: Frontend teams need clear evidence before fixing interface problems. This skill produces a prioritized audit across accessibility, performance, theming, responsiveness, and design patterns.
actual_capabilities: Checks accessibility issues such as contrast, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, alt text, and form labels.
Reviews frontend performance concerns including layout thrashing, expensive animations, asset optimization, bundle size, and render behavior.
Identifies theming problems such as hard-coded colors, broken dark mode, inconsistent tokens, and theme switching gaps.
Evaluates responsive design issues including fixed widths, small touch targets, horizontal overflow, text scaling, and missing breakpoints.
Produces a structured audit report with severity, impact, standards, recommendations, priorities, and suggested follow-up commands.
limitations: It documents issues but does not apply fixes.
It depends on available project files, tools, and installed companion skills.
It cannot replace manual testing with real assistive technologies.
It may miss runtime issues that require production traffic or device-specific testing.

use_cases.title: Pre-release frontend review
use_cases.description: Audit a new feature before launch and rank blocking issues by user impact.

use_cases.title: Design system compliance check
use_cases.description: Find hard-coded styles, broken dark mode states, and inconsistent token usage across interface files.

use_cases.title: Accessibility remediation planning
use_cases.description: Create a clear issue list with WCAG context, affected locations, and recommended fix priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Audit one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused interface area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the settings page for accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive design. List only issues that need action.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize release blockers
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before a product release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the checkout flow and identify critical or high severity issues that should block release. Include impact and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review design system usage
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across shared frontend components.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit shared UI components for token usage, dark mode support, responsive behavior, and recurring design anti-patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create remediation roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning after a broad product audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the full dashboard experience and group findings into immediate, short-term, medium-term, and long-term remediation work.

output_examples.output: A prioritized report with an anti-pattern verdict, executive summary, findings by severity, systemic issues, positive findings, and fix priorities.

output_examples.input: Review a component library for theming quality.
output_examples.output: A component-focused audit that identifies token misuse, dark mode gaps, contrast problems, and recommended normalization work.
A responsive and accessibility report covering touch targets, overflow, keyboard access, form labels, and release-blocking issues.

best_practices: Run the audit on a specific feature or flow when possible.
Provide screenshots, routes, or component names to improve location accuracy.
Use the priority sections to plan fixes before starting implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to fix issues during the audit.
Do not treat every visual concern as critical severity.
Do not rely on the audit as the only accessibility validation step.

faq.question: Does this skill change my code?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to document issues and recommend fixes, not modify files.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What areas does it audit?
faq.answer: It covers accessibility, performance, theming, responsive design, and frontend design anti-patterns.

faq.question: Can it find WCAG issues?
faq.answer: It can identify likely WCAG-related problems and explain impact, but manual verification remains important.

faq.question: Will it suggest follow-up work?
faq.answer: Yes. It groups recommendations by priority and can suggest available commands for specific fixes.

faq.question: Is it useful for existing products?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review mature interfaces and highlight systemic quality problems across many components.
